record.category: shared seedbox (app hosting with torrent clients)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no free trial. The only no-cost way in is the refund window: 'All plans come with a - no questions asked - money back guarantee during the first week of your service!'
free_tier.notes: the first-week refund is a paid trial, not a trial that starts at zero

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the plan is sold by total disk (2 TB on Bat Box), not by largest single object; no per-file cap is published

retention.stated: until the subscription ends; no inactivity deletion is stated
retention.notes: not applicable in the debrid sense: the box holds what is put on it while it is paid

egress.terms: Bat Box includes 10 TB of upload traffic per month on a 50Gbit/50Gbit server uplink; 'After using your monthly traffic quota, upload speed is limited to 10 Mbit/s for the remainder of the month. Download speed remains unlimited.' No overage price is published.
egress.free_allowance: 10 TB/month upload (Bat Box); 15 TB Gremlin, 20 TB Vampire, 30 TB Zombie, 40 TB Red Dragon

record.interface_detail: FTP and SFTP are documented in the vendor's own docs and community guides (FileZilla connection guides, multi-part FTP downloading); the Seedbucket web file manager is included on every plan.
record.tooling: FileZilla, aria2/lftp per vendor guides; Seedbucket file manager and downloader; no rclone backend is documented
record.chaining: A 10 TB/month box feeding a home NAS or a cloud mount; the monthly upload counter, not the 50 Gbit port, decides how much can actually be pulled before 10 Mbit/s shaping

limits.value: 10 TB upload per month on the entry Bat Box plan
upload limited to 10 Mbit/s after the monthly quota, until reset

record.limits_note: Entry plan is EUR 14.35/month for 2 TB, so nothing here is under USD 5; the record exists to price the paid ladder. 10 TB over 30 days is 3.86 MB/s, or 30.9 Mbit/s, sustained.
record.binding_note: The 10 TB/month upload counter is reached long before the 50 Gbit port is saturated: 10 TB/month is 30.9 Mbit/s sustained, one 1,600th of the port.

identity_cost.detail: An account is required and there is no free tier, so a payment method is needed to use the service at all. No identity document or phone verification is stated on the page read.

record.reliability_note: After the monthly upload quota the account is shaped to 10 Mbit/s rather than billed; download stays unlimited.
record.confidence_note: Pricing, quota and throttle are on the live plan page read on 2026-10-23. A measured rung would need an account and a transfer run, which on 2026-10-23 did not buy.

evidence.proved: Bat Box EUR 14.35/mo with 2 TB storage and 10 TB upload traffic on a 50Gbit/50Gbit uplink; 'upload speed is limited to 10 Mbit/s for the remainder of the month'; one-week money-back, no free tier
FTP and SFTP are supported access paths; the docs index lists 'Optimize FTP downloads from your seedbox with multi-part (multi-segmented) downloading'

record.notes: 10 TB -> 3.86 MB/s -> 30.9 Mbit/s. The page supports the first two as positioning, not as a measured cost.

extras.apps: 40+ one-click apps including Plex, Emby, Jellyfin; Seedbucket; WireGuard VPN
